## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A five-*juan* Sòng-period subcommentary on Huìsī's *Dàshèng zhǐguān fǎmén* ([KR6d0152](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0152), T1924) by **Liǎorán** 了然 (1077–1141), the Northern-through-Southern Sòng Tiāntái master and *Vinaya* expert. The work is the principal Sòng-period subcommentary on Huìsī's foundational pre-Tiāntái meditation manual.

**Abstract**

Liǎorán's *Zōngyuán jì* — its title literally "lineage-perfecting notes" — provides systematic Sòng *shānjiā* 山家 commentary on Huìsī's foundational meditation manual, integrating the work into the standard Tiāntái scholastic tradition. The composition is bracketed within Liǎorán's productive period c. 1095–1141.
